Rocko's Modern Life, or why I don't like Spongebob

Well, Spongebob had almost the same staff that Rocko's Modern Life had. But I agree that Rocko's Modern Life had a lot of sexual innuendos and adult jokes that went over kids heads at the time but would make it entertaining for adults to watch as well. I find it similar to the way that Pixar mixes in adult jokes that kids can't grasp until they're older which makes it enjoyable for all ages.

I also think Spongebob is just .. too stupid. Rocko had some characters that weren't the most intelligent but I can't think of anything in comparison to Patrick and I don't think Heffer was even nearly as naive/ignorant as Spongebob is. While Spongebob was alright for the first few seasons I thought the quality really dropped after only a few seasons. Though, at that point I was pretty much done with the Nickelodeon lineup anyway so that may skew my perspective a little as well.
